top_signals.title: Wall Street Says Stay With Stocks Despite Late ‘90s Dot-Com Vibe
top_signals.summary: Rising bond yields and soaring oil prices have many Wall Street pros looking back a few decades to the volatile period before the dot-com crash. But that doesn’t mean they’re encouraging investors to dump their stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
